actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 384 - 25 (Roll no. 45). (text: CR H740)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 384 - 25 (Roll no. 45). (text: CR H740)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR S749-750)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 818.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H740-742)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects all federal agencies evaluated under the small business contracting scorecard program and new small business contractors.
dimensions.evidence: requires federal agencies to include on their annual scorecard for small business contracting the number of small businesses that receive a prime contract for the first time

dimensions.assessment: Modifies federal reporting requirements and metrics rather than altering direct funding or substantive contracting rules.
dimensions.evidence: The number of new small business entrants... awarded prime contracts in each North American Industry Classification System code during the fiscal year

dimensions.assessment: No additional amounts are authorized to be appropriated to carry out the act.
dimensions.evidence: No additional amounts are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this Act or the amendments made by this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 15(y) of the Small Business Act to update agency scorecard metric requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 15(y) of the Small Business Act (15 U.S.C. 644(y)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent ongoing reporting modifications for annual federal agency scorecards.
dimensions.evidence: include on their annual scorecard for small business contracting the number of small businesses that receive a prime contract for the first time

missing_information: Exact administrative cost to federal agencies for gathering the new scorecard data.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires federal agencies to include new small business contract entrants and specific socioeconomic categories on their annual small business contracting scorecards, without authorizing additional appropriations.
